name: Phạm Văn Đồng
role: Prime Minister of Vietnam from 1976 to 1987
contribution: A Vietnamese politician who served as Prime Minister of North Vietnam from 1955 to 1976.

checks.lead: Phạm Văn Đồng (Vietnamese: [fâːmˀ vɐ̄n ɗòŋ͡m] ; 1 March 1906 – 29 April 2000) was a Vietnamese politician who served as Prime Minister of North Vietnam from 1955 to 1976. He later served as Prime Minister of Vietnam, following reunification of North and South Vietnam, from 1976 until he retired in 1987 under the presidency of Trường Chinh and Nguyễn Văn Linh. He was considered one of Ho Chi Minh's closest lieutenants.
